title: Judgments on the home and coverage pages
goal: The public home page and the coverage page say what Hulft now covers: Supreme Court and Court of Appeal judgments from 2021, now published to kb (court-judgments #63). Update the home content and the coverage (user, 2026-11-17).
for_whom: A Sri Lankan lawyer deciding whether Hulft covers what they argue from.

done_check.check: The counts band (home and coverage pages) has 6 cells, 3 rows of 2, all live from kb: Acts and Laws, Revised Edition chapters, Judgments (ca: + sc:, 4,557 on 2026-11-17), Gazettes, Amendments followed, Last updated; each number matches a count of kb.docs / kb.links.

The coverage page lists Judgments among what it covers (Supreme Court and Court of Appeal, from 2021) and no longer says judgments are not yet covered; the home page's 'Judgments are next' trust item and the FAQ's 'Judgments come next' say judgments from 2021 are in. Years only: no mention of the Supreme Court's gap after August 2026 (user).
Both pages walked in the headed browser on desktop and phone width (counts read with a targeted eval, the 6-cell grid seen), light and dark.

scenarios.steps: Open the home page, then Coverage, as a lawyer who wants to know if judgments are in.
scenarios.expect: Both say Supreme Court and Court of Appeal judgments from 2021 are covered, and show the live judgments count.

out_of_scope: The app citing judgments in chat (the next brief).
Mentioning the Supreme Court's gap after August 2026 (user: years only); the live-site spider is #71.
Any other change to the pages' design.
